scope: Developer checks on the real local desktop and Blender; not user acceptance.

display.problem: Overlay stayed on an external display while Blender was on the built-in display. The first layer-0 Blender window was a tiny 66x20 helper.
display.fix: Follow the largest-intersecting display of the first normal foreground-app window with width and height over 100. Keep the overlay fixed while dragging.

targetRestore.problem: Slow initial Blender connection caused clipboard fallback to replace the saved Blender target.
targetRestore.regressionTest: a saved Blender target survives a slow startup connection

undo.problem: Assigning unchanged parent/world matrices during undo introduced transform rounding drift after dependency-graph evaluation.
undo.fix: Only restore parent/world matrices that changed; update the dependency graph before checking restoration.

recordings.detail: First foreground recording exposed the delayed undo drift. Second recording was interrupted by the Mac locking before execution. Neither is a successful final full-flow video.
recordings.next: Unlock, hold the display awake for the recording session, then record browser Copy, image thumbnail, real preview, apply, undo and delayed fingerprint readback.
